Rates & important details

See booking page

Book online to receive the displayed dynamic price; those prices are not offered by phone or in person. The course lists a $5 surcharge when requesting a cart for one player. Confirm how the surcharge applies before booking. During evening league season, contact the golf shop before planning an 18-hole round after 4 PM.
